label: Task assistant
title: Task assistant
runningOn: The profile, runner and model this conversation runs on
noProfiles: No profile yet: add one in Providers

unavailable.not_ready: not signed in or no key

closeTitle: Closing stops the assistant. The conversation and drafts stay; your next message resumes it.

empty.lead: Describe what you want done or found out. The assistant reads the project, asks when something is unclear, and drafts tasks you can edit.
empty.example: For example: "The Windows build got slow and CI reinstalls everything. Find out why and plan a fix."

placeholder: Describe the work or a question to research
keys: Enter sends · Shift Enter adds a line · Esc stops and closes
note: Read-only: it never edits files or starts runs. Spend counts against the profile's key. Stops after {{minutes}} min idle.

spend.title: What this conversation spent on the profile's key; it counts against the key's daily cap
spend.planTitle: A plan sign-in or local model: tokens count against the plan, not in dollars

notice.denied: Refused a request to write, run a command or use the network: the assistant is read-only.
notice.question_cancelled: The agent tried to ask through a dialog; it was told to ask in its reply instead.
notice.undelivered: Messages still waiting were not sent: the session ended first.

ended.closed: Stopped: you pressed Stop and close or Esc. Your next message resumes it.
ended.ended: The runner ended the session. Your next message starts it again.
ended.idle: Stopped after sitting idle. Your next message resumes it.
ended.daily_cap: Stopped: the key reached its daily cap.
ended.not_eligible: Stopped: the profile can no longer run the assistant.
ended.admission: Could not start: no free slot.

announce.replied_one: The assistant replied. {{count}} draft is waiting for you.
announce.replied_other: The assistant replied. {{count}} drafts are waiting for you.

drafts.label: Task drafts
drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.empty: Drafts the assistant proposes appear here. Nothing starts until you add one and approve its crew.
drafts.fieldQuestions: Questions to answer, one per line
drafts.added: Added to Tasks. Its crew waits for your approval.

suggest.title: Asks the assistant once, on the profile above; the cost beside it is our estimate before you press it
suggest.message: Suggest tasks for this project. Look through the code and propose three to five tasks that would help it most, each with a kind, acceptance criteria and a size.
suggest.lead: The assistant looks through the code once and proposes three to five drafts.

report.label: Report
report.truncated: Part of the report was cut to fit.
report.suggestedNote: From the findings and the agent's follow-ups. Nothing starts until you add one and approve its crew.
report.addAllNote: “Add all as drafts” puts each open card in Tasks as it reads now, your edits included. Nothing starts until you approve each crew.
report.addAllInvalid: A card has no title. Give it one, or discard it, before adding all.
report.addedAll_one: {{count}} task added. Its crew waits for your approval in Tasks.
report.addedAll_other: {{count}} tasks added. Each crew waits for your approval in Tasks.

errors.assistant_message_too_long: That message is over 8 KB. Shorten it or split it.
errors.assistant_profile_in_use: The assistant is running on another profile. Stop it first to switch.
errors.assistant_stopping: The assistant is stopping. Send again in a moment.
errors.assistant_unavailable_not_ready: That profile is not signed in or has no key.
errors.assistant_unavailable_no_read_only: That profile's runner cannot run read-only.
errors.assistant_unavailable_no_mcp: That profile's runner cannot take Crewyard's tools, so it could not propose drafts.
errors.assistant_unavailable_no_adapter: Crewyard cannot run that profile's runner.
errors.assistant_daily_cap: The key reached its daily cap. Raise the cap in Providers or pick another profile.
errors.admission_global_slots: Every agent slot is in use. Try again when a run finishes.
errors.admission_profile_busy: That profile already runs as many agents as it may.
errors.admission_memory: Not enough free memory to start another agent.
errors.assistant_draft_added: That draft is already a task.
errors.assistant_draft_adding: That draft is being added already.
errors.assistant_draft_invalid: Check the draft: a one-line title of at most 120 bytes, at most 12 short criteria.
errors.assistant_preset_unknown: That ready-made task does not exist.
errors.assistant_too_many_drafts: This conversation already has 20 drafts. Add or discard some first.

refused.read_usage: Could not read spend and limits
refused.list_agent_files: Could not list instruction files and skills

readOnlyTitle: It reads the project and never edits files or starts runs. Spend counts against the profile's key.
about: About the assistant: keys, read-only, spend
keysShort: Enter sends · Shift Enter: new line
stopTitle: Stops this reply and the session. The conversation stays; your next message resumes it.
bytesTitle: A message can be at most 8 KB

live.elapsed: Time since this turn began: your message, or a note from Autopilot
live.queued_one: {{count}} message goes when this turn ends
live.queued_other: {{count}} messages go when this turn ends

actions.label: Reply actions
actions.draftsTitle: Sends a message asking the assistant to turn this reply into task drafts. It costs like any message.
actions.draftsMessage: Turn your reply that starts with "{{excerpt}}" into task drafts: call propose_task once for each task in it, with a kind, acceptance criteria and a size.
